text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On my way back to the academy after a
shopping trip, I see a Tracen
student in
front of me.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Phew... Okay, break time's over.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I need to hurry back... and move on to the
next training exercise.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
You can do this,
Rice! Believe in yourself...
Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower runs with a strong spring to
her step. The aura she
possesses in spite of
her small build piques my curiosity.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Entranced by her running form, I continue
following her down the
road towards the
academy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She gets stopped by a red light...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Sigh.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And another red light...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ahhh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
How many red lights is this now?! Today is
definitely not her lucky
day...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We end up waiting at every single
crosswalk, so by the time we finally
arrive
at Tracen Academy, the sun has already
long set.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: No big deal. I wasn't in a rush or anythi—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Um... I-I'm so sorry!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Th-that's right. Um... I'm r-really...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I'm really sorry!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I mean...
It only took you this long to come
back to the academy
because I was
running next to you the whole time...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I'm so, so sorry!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
No, it was clearly my fault.
I'm a hopeless
girl who only brings
misfortune upon
everyone...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
So let me apologize... D-don't worry! If I
leave, everything will be
fine! Goodbye!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower dashes off without giving me
a chance to stop her... I
feel bad for
making her worry so much about me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I head off in the same direction as Rice
Shower.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant, pant... Sigh.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Uuugh. I wonder if the person just now
was okay being this late.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
What if they were really, really hungry...
Or what if they missed the
newest episode
of their favorite TV show...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Sigh... Why am I always like this?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seems like she worries an awful lot about
other people. Perhaps she
just needs some
encourageme—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Nuh-uh, I have to try even harder!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I already made up my mind to enter the
upcoming tryouts. I'll actually
enter,
actually run, and then...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'll make my debut and win a bunch of
races. Then, I won't be a
burden anymore!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Mhm... And that means more training!
Rice, you can do this! Believe in
yourself...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She suddenly starts training with such
intense fervor that I can't bring
myself to interrupt her. Ultimately,
I miss my chance
to talk to her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower... I'm looking forward to
seeing her run at the upcoming
tryouts.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Finally, it's the day of the tryouts. The
venue is filled to the brim with
trainers
looking to scout talented runners.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Suddenly—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Rice! Ricety-rice-rice!
Wherefore art thou,
Riiiiice?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
As class rep, it's my duty to inform you
that your race is about to
begin!

text_block_list.name: Tryouts Official A
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Bakushin O, isn't your race the one
after? Make sure you don't
miss your race
either!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Wha?!

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
So Rice Shower is boycotting even the
tryouts now? She has talent,
but it's all
going to waste.

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
She can have all the talent in the world,
but if she doesn't want to
race, then that's
that.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The tryouts reach their conclusion, but
Rice Shower is nowhere to be
found.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Later that night, I spot her out of the
corner of my eye.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hic... Waaa—waaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'm such a dumb dummy! I even said I was
going to try my very, very
best...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Sniffle... Why... Why am I so worthless?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can't just stand by and watch her cry
like
this, so I walk up and call
out to her.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Y-you're... from the other day?
